bounce.name: Bounce

appearance.body: Large, chunky, fluffy — big warm presence
appearance.fur: Bold orange with darker tabby stripes
appearance.eyes: Large vivid bright green, highly expressive
appearance.clothing: Casual — sometimes a messenger bag slung across body

bounce.personality: Warm, funny, energetic, slightly panicky — heart of gold
bounce.voice_profile: Warm, expressive Nigerian male. Confident but slightly dramatic. British-Nigerian swagger. Friendly and conversational. Clear pronunciation of BootHop.
bounce.dalle_prompt_prefix: 3D animated Pixar-quality film style, original BootHop character, large fluffy orange tabby cat named Bounce, large vivid green eyes, bold orange fur with darker tabby stripes, white muzzle and whiskers, big expressive face, chunky friendly build, premium cinema render, no text in image

dash.name: Dash

appearance.body: Small, compact, slim — much smaller than Bounce
appearance.clothing: Always carrying a travel bag or small box

dash.personality: Quick, confident, calm, dry wit — the organised one
dash.voice_profile: Slightly different Nigerian voice — smaller, quicker, cheekier, more energetic. Dry and deadpan. Calm even when chaos is happening.
dash.dalle_prompt_prefix: 3D animated Pixar-quality film style, original BootHop character, small grey-blue anthropomorphic mouse named Dash, large round grey mouse ears, slim compact build much smaller than Bounce, quick confident posture, always carrying a travel bag or small box, premium cinema render, no text in image

rules.consistency: Bounce = large orange cat. Dash = small grey-blue mouse. Never swap or confuse them.
rules.originality: Original BootHop characters — must match the reference videos exactly
rules.references: bounce_ref.png for Bounce scenes, whatsapp_a_2s.png for Dash reference
rules.branding: Do not generate text or the BootHop logo inside AI-created scenes — add during final editing
rules.logo: Use only the official supplied BootHop logo. Never redraw, reinterpret or misspell it.
